description: The embedding matrix E (column a is the vector of character a), its principal components (coordinates of each character on the top 3, and the fraction of variance each explains), and the cosine similarity of every pair of characters. The same for the initial E, for contrast. E starts as N(0, 1) noise and training moves it comparatively little, so its principal components are dominated by that noise. The readout vectors (the rows of Wout, which start near 0) are all learned: readout.pca shows the model's own geometry of the alphabet.
